act_title: The Supreme Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Act, 1958
title: Sumptuary allowance.―The Chief Justice and each of the other Judges shall be entitled to
text:
23B. Sumptuary allowance.―The Chief Justice and each of the other Judges shall be entitled to

a sumptuary allowance of [ [forty-five thousand] ] rupees per month and [ [thirty-four thousand]]
rupees] per month respectively.
